key_insight: Machine learning can accelerate computer algebra by guiding algorithmic choices and, in some cases, performing symbolic computation directly.
engineering_relevance: ML-guided symbolic tools could reduce computational costs in engineering workflows that rely on algebraic computation.
method: Systematically review ML applications in computer algebra.
Cover cylindrical algebraic decomposition, Gröbner bases, symbolic integration, and other tasks.
Compare approaches ranging from decision trees to transformers.
evidence_signal: The survey synthesizes prior work but identifies a shortage of benchmark datasets that limits method comparison and assessment of generalization.
watch_item: ML-generated symbolic results should be mathematically verified rather than assumed to inherit the guarantees of traditional symbolic methods.
paper_title: A Survey on the Use of Machine Learning within Computer Algebra
